title: Pure Argostars
summary: Argostars cards with Macro Cosmos, Time Thief Redoer and generic staples. Argostars is a LIGHT/DARK Warrior and Continuous Trap-monster engine where Glorious Adra places two Continuous Traps straight from the Deck and every Trap hops between the Monster Zone and Spell & Trap Zone.

summary.title: Starters
points: Argostars - Glorious Adra banishes itself from the field or hand to place up to 2 Argostars Continuous Traps with different names face-up from the Deck, and on the turn Adra is Normal Summoned the opponent cannot respond to your Argostars Continuous Trap activations.
Argostars - Giantslaying is a Quick-Play that searches any Argostars monster (and immediately grants a Warrior Normal Summon if you control or have a banished Warrior).
Argostars - Lightning Tydeu discards a card to Special Summon itself from the Spell & Trap Zone as a Level 4 Warrior, searches any Argostars card, and places itself back in the Spell & Trap Zone.

summary.title: Opening: Glorious Adra or Giantslaying
steps: Normal Summon Argostars - Glorious Adra and banish it during Main Phase 1 to place Argostars - Lightning Tydeu and Argostars - Slayer Eteo (or Swift Capane) face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone.
Activate Lightning Tydeu by discarding a card to Special Summon itself, search Argostars - Home Stadium (or Argostars - Fierce Parthe), and return to the Spell & Trap Zone.
Activate Home Stadium to add a banished Argostars card or set up burn and negation, then overlay two Level 4 Trap monsters into Argostars - Adventurous Arion to search another Argostars Spell.

summary.title: Continuous Trap Monsters & Fierce Parthe
summary.text: While in the Spell & Trap Zone, Lightning Tydeu, Slayer Eteo and Swift Capane give your Warriors continuous buffs (500 ATK/DEF, effect-destruction immunity, or battle-destruction immunity) and Special Summon themselves as Level 4 Warriors on either turn: Eteo bounces a card on the field when the opponent activates an effect while you have a banished Warrior, and Capane summons itself alongside another Trap monster. Argostars - Fierce Parthe bounces a face-up Argostars Continuous Trap from your field to the hand as a Quick Effect to Special Summon itself, then banishes itself to Set an Argostars Trap.

summary.title: Extra Deck, Field Spell & Macro Cosmos
points: Argostars - Adventurous Arion (Rank 4) searches an Argostars Spell on Xyz Summon and places up to 3 Argostars Continuous Traps from your GY face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone during the Standby Phase.

Argostars - Home Stadium recovers an Argostars card from the GY or banishment once per turn, burns 500 LP each time a Continuous Trap is Special Summoned from the Spell & Trap Zone, and negates an opposing face-up card when a Trap monster activates while you have a banished Argostars.
Macro Cosmos banishes every card sent to the GY while keeping your banished Argostars monsters online for Home Stadium, Giantslaying and Slayer Eteo.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's Fiendsmith side engine is omitted here to keep the build pure Argostars and Rank 4 Warrior control.
